pages:job-application.title: Job Application
pages:job-application.description: The complete route after Job Detail: shared careers navigation, one role-aware application form with a summary rail and file upload, then the shared site footer.

pages:careers.title: Careers
pages:careers.description: A complete hiring route with pink character-led orientation, working principles, concrete benefits, open roles, a plain four-part hiring process, job alerts, and the shared varunUI site footer.

pages:contact.title: Contact
pages:contact.description: A character-led contact page that sets response expectations, collects only useful project context, and confirms the handoff to a real support person.

pages:job-detail.title: Job Detail
pages:job-detail.description: A complete Marker-led role description with plain facts, ruled responsibility and requirement lists, useful experience, and one application action.
